The '''S-4 Underwater Torpedo Launcher''' was a weapon system produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]]. It was designed to be used against [[Submarine/Legends|submersibles]] and held one torpedo. Three of the launchers were installed near [[Quekka Trench Station]] by [[Pinae Wettan]] for defense.<ref name="HS" />
